'''August 2001 Fitchburg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fitchburg, MA in August 2001. It is known from Stephen Cellucci's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2922">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-03-you-need-to-get-divorced-milford-mad2922/ you-need-to-get-divorced-milford-ma], DeckTech (Stephen "The Gov'na" Cellucci, 3 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-03-you-need-to-get-divorced-milford-mad2922/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Site:''' Fitchburg, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 7
